label: Diamond
depicts: Cut gemstone shape with a flat top center facets and pointed bottom
use_when: Use when the interface wants a cut gemstone with visible facet lines across the center.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain diamond outline when the shape should stay empty inside.

label: Disabled
depicts: Wheelchair symbol with a seated figure above one large rear wheel
use_when: Use when the interface wants a seated wheelchair figure with an upright torso and wheel.
avoid_when: Do not use for the leaning wheelchair figure when the upper body should angle forward.

label: Disabled
depicts: Wheelchair symbol with a leaning figure above one large rear wheel
use_when: Use when the interface wants the wheelchair figure leaning forward into the wheel.
avoid_when: Do not use for the more upright wheelchair symbol when the upper body should stay straight.

label: Drawer
depicts: Tall chest form with three drawers stacked above two short feet
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tall chest with three stacked drawers and tiny feet.
avoid_when: Do not use for the two drawer cabinet when the top should not extend into a third drawer.

label: Drawer
depicts: Small cabinet form with two drawers flat top and two short feet
use_when: Use when the interface wants a compact two drawer cabinet with a flat top panel.
avoid_when: Do not use for the three drawer chest when a taller stacked cabinet should be visible.
